Dhaka To Tanguar Haor | Dhaka To Sunamganj Sleeper Bus Journey | Imperial Express | Travel Of Life | Travel Vlog: 25

Assalamualaikum Everyone, welcome to Travel Of Life. Today I am traveling from Dhaka to Sunamganj by Sleeper bus and I am sharing my experience with you. An easy route from Sunamganj to Tanguar Haor.
Dhaka to Sunamganj Sleeper bus fare: 1600/- 

I have brought to you the Dhaka to Sunamganj Sleeper Bus Journey.
